provenance.note: Tilia americana (American basswood) is the drawable stand-in for Tilia cordata (small-leaved lime), the linden that lines Berlin's streets and stands in old courtyards. provenance.note: Platanus occidentalis (American sycamore) is the drawable stand-in for Platanus × acerifolia (London plane), the archetypal Berlin street tree. The hybrid sign is dropped to give Platanus acerifolia, per docs/locale-richness.md. Growth form, evergreen flag, height_m and crown_width_m are the stand-in model's, from schema/v0.1/flora-taxa.json; its 36.5 m crown is very wide, so it is given a small share (0.3) and the importer may simply leave it out of a small courtyard. native_status follows the Wikipedia article on Platanus × acerifolia, a hybrid with no natural range, planted throughout Germany. community_weight is judgement: a relative share of 0.3 among the courtyard's trees, divided by the importer's 0.3 multiplier for Introduced plants.
